title: Translating sulfur flow batteries into deployable systems - Nature Energy
text:
Sulfur-based redox flow batteries promise low-cost, long-duration energy storage using abundant active materials, but commercial success depends on much more than low-cost materials. Yi-Chun Lu and her team explore how deployment reshapes research priorities and reveals the scientific and engineering bottlenecks that determine technology translation.
